The work this project has finished, from its own delivery records. Each group reads its 50 most recent work orders that finished `done`; a group under 10 is labeled low confidence, with what an estimate from it would say. Delivery time leaves out waiting for a lane, lane time is how long a lane held a place, and cost is estimated at list price. These figures are history and no promise: use them to size work and choose agents, and do not write an estimate.

To find them, ropeshift ignored the capability class, the repository, the merge authority level, and the number of criteria. They took from 1h to 7h.
